_note: [KEPUTUSAN] default event templates (SPEC §10). Admins create events from these; every number can be changed per event.

sunday_long_run.name: Sunday Long Run @Higround
sunday_long_run.description: Long run minimal 10 km, start dari Higround. Check-in otomatis dari lari kamu, XP lari dikali 2.

monthly_virtual.name: Monthly Virtual Challenge
monthly_virtual.description: Kumpulkan 50 km lari sebulan, dari mana saja. Badge untuk yang tembus target.

run_brew.name: Run + Brew
run_brew.description: Habis lari, mampir ke Higround dan scan QR di kasir. Dapat bonus XP.

yoga_saturday.name: Yoga Saturday
yoga_saturday.description: Kelas yoga di Studio Room lantai 2. Bintang dari instruktur (Class Mode) plus bonus XP.
